title: TOM BRADY LEAVES BIRMINGHAM, AND BIRMINGHAM GO TOP. COINCIDENCE?
description:
Top of the Championship, seven wins from nine, and the famous minority owner is out.

Birmingham beat Swansea 2-1 and lead the Championship with 29 points from 15 games. Meanwhile, Tom Brady has left his ownership role. The club has given no reason.

Brady held 3.3 percent of the club and chaired a new advisory board from August 2023. During that time Wayne Rooney was hired, then sacked 83 days later. Last summer Birmingham also paid a record 15 million pounds for Jay Stansfield.

We're not saying one caused the other. We're saying the timing is hard to ignore.

Did Brady's exit change anything, or is this just football's sense of timing? Give us your take.
